description: This file defines an internal interface 'IRemoteGrainDirectory' in the Orleans.Runtime namespace, which manages distributed grain directory operations such as registering activations, looking up grains, and accepting split partitions within a silo in a distributed Orleans application.

methods.name: RegisterMany
methods.description: Registers multiple grain activations remotely during handoff.

methods.name: LookUpMany
methods.description: Fetches updated information on a list of grains, used to refresh directory caches.

methods.name: AcceptSplitPartition
methods.description: Registers activations from a split partition with the directory.
